# Redshift Insert

Inserts one row per envelope into an Amazon Redshift table, each column a value or an expression on the envelope. Rows go in batches of one table, each in one transaction (all or none of that batch); each envelope goes on with {action: "inserted"} in its output key (default `redshift`). A test run writes nothing.

- Type: `redshift-insert` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `redshift` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: yes (a test run does not write)

## Settings

| Key                | Label             | Kind       | Required | Default                           | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `connection`       | Connection        | connection |          |                                   | profile type `redshift`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `connectionName`   | Connection name   | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env`                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `host`             | Host              | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `port`             | Port              | number     | yes      | `"5439"`                          | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `database`         | Database          | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `user`             | User              | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `password`         | Password          | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `ssl`              | SSL               | select     | yes      | `"on"`                            | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `table`            | Table             | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | schema.table or table; with fx, an expression on the envelope (e.g. $tenant + ".customers"), its result checked the same way. A batch is one table: an envelope whose table is another closes the batch (envelopes sorted by table, e.g. a Sort before it, make full batches instead of small ones), and each batch is atomic on its own (all or none of that batch, never of the run). The last log line says what happened per table.; e.g. `sales.customers` |
| `columns`          | Columns           | list       | yes      |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `columns[].column` | Column            | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `columns[].value`  | Value             | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `batchSize`        | Batch size        | number     |          | `500`                             | The most rows per batch (one transaction); an envelope of another table closes the batch before that.; 1 to 5000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `timeoutS`         | Timeout (seconds) | number     |          | `300`                             | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>
table: sales.order_events
columns:
    - column: order_id
      value: $id
      expression: true
    - column: status
      value: $status
      expression: true
    - column: source
      value: flowtinus
      expression: false
batchSize: 500
```

# Redshift Query

Runs a read-only query (one SELECT or WITH) on Amazon Redshift once per incoming envelope and yields one envelope per row, the columns written into DATA (Override: only the columns). The `@name`s are parameters, each a value or an expression on the envelope (sent as $1, $2..., never pasted into the text); a `{{name}}` is a schema or table name picked in the run (the parameter's value, checked: name or schema.name, letters, digits, _ and $). Connects with a connection profile of the workspace (its id in `connection`) or the component's own fields, the password always a secret.

- Type: `redshift` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key                  | Label             | Kind       | Required | Default                          | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------- | ----------------- | ---------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `connection`         | Connection        | connection |          |                                  | profile type `redshift`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `connectionName`     | Connection name   | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}` | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env` |
| `host`               | Host              | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `port`               | Port              | number     | yes      | `"5439"`                         | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `database`           | Database          | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `user`               | User              | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `password`           | Password          | secret     | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `ssl`                | SSL               | select     | yes      | `"on"`                           | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `sql`                | Query             | code       | yes      |                                  | sql; e.g. `SELECT id, name FROM sales.customers WHERE updated_at > @since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `parameters`         | Parameters        | list       |          |                                  | Each @name the query uses, with its value. A list of values for IN: split it in the query (e.g. split_to_array(@ids, ',')). A {{name}} in the query (e.g. FROM {{schema}}.briefs) is pasted as a name, after it is checked; a list of names is pasted as a, b, c.                              |
| `parameters[].name`  | Name              | text       | yes      |                                  | e.g. `since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `parameters[].value` | Value             | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$PARAMETERS.since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `timeoutS`           | Timeout (seconds) | number     |          | `300`                            | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>
sql: SELECT email, name FROM sales.customers WHERE region = @region AND updated_at > @since
parameters:
    - name: region
      value: $region
      expression: true
    - name: since
      value: $PARAMETERS.since
      expression: true
timeoutS: 120
```

# Redshift Upsert

Writes one row per envelope into an Amazon Redshift table: the row whose Match on columns are equal is updated, otherwise it is inserted (Redshift does not enforce primary keys). Rows go in batches of one table, each in one transaction; in a batch the last envelope with the same match values wins. Each envelope goes on with {action: "inserted" | "updated" | "superseded"} in its output key (default `redshift`). A test run writes nothing.

- Type: `redshift-upsert` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `redshift` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: yes (a test run does not write)

## Settings

| Key                | Label             | Kind       | Required | Default                           | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `connection`       | Connection        | connection |          |                                   | profile type `redshift`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `connectionName`   | Connection name   | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env`                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `host`             | Host              | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `port`             | Port              | number     | yes      | `"5439"`                          | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `database`         | Database          | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `user`             | User              | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `password`         | Password          | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `ssl`              | SSL               | select     | yes      | `"on"`                            | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `table`            | Table             | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | schema.table or table; with fx, an expression on the envelope (e.g. $tenant + ".customers"), its result checked the same way. A batch is one table: an envelope whose table is another closes the batch (envelopes sorted by table, e.g. a Sort before it, make full batches instead of small ones), and each batch is atomic on its own (all or none of that batch, never of the run). The last log line says what happened per table.; e.g. `sales.customers` |
| `columns`          | Columns           | list       | yes      |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `columns[].column` | Column            | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `columns[].value`  | Value             | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `match`            | Match on          | list       | yes      |                                   | The columns that find the row to update (among the Columns); no match: the row is inserted.; each item is a plain value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `match[].column`   | Column            | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `id`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `batchSize`        | Batch size        | number     |          | `500`                             | The most rows per batch (one transaction); an envelope of another table closes the batch before that.; 1 to 5000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `timeoutS`         | Timeout (seconds) | number     |          | `300`                             | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>
table: sales.customers
columns:
    - column: email
      value: $email
      expression: true
    - column: name
      value: $name
      expression: true
    - column: updated_at
      value: new Date()
      expression: true
match:
    - email
batchSize: 500
```

# SQL Server Delete

Deletes SQL Server rows, one DELETE per envelope: the rows whose Match on columns all equal the envelope's values (each a value or an expression on the envelope; null or undefined is an error for that envelope, never a wider delete). Batches of one table, in one transaction each (all or none of that batch). Each envelope goes on with {action: "deleted", rows} or {action: "notFound"} in its output key (default `sqlserver`). A test run deletes nothing.

- Type: `sqlserver-delete` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `sqlserver` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: yes (a test run does not write)

## Settings

| Key                      | Label                    | Kind       | Required | Default                           | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------ | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `connection`             | Connection               | connection |          |                                   | profile type `sqlserver`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `connectionName`         | Connection name          | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env`                                                                                                                                                               |
| `connectWith`            | Connect with             | select     | yes      | `"fields"`                        | one of `fields`, `string`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `host`                   | Host                     | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `port`                   | Port                     | number     | yes      | `"1433"`                          | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `database`               | Database                 | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `user`                   | User                     | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `password`               | Password                 | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `encrypt`                | Encrypt                  | select     | yes      | `"on"`                            | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `trustServerCertificate` | Trust server certificate | select     | yes      | `"off"`                           | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `connectionString`       | Connection string        | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"string"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `table`                  | Table                    | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | schema.table or table; with fx, an expression on the envelope (e.g. $tenant + ".customers"), its result checked the same way. A batch is one table: an envelope whose table is another closes the batch (envelopes sorted by table, e.g. a Sort before it, make full batches instead of small ones), and each batch is atomic on its own (all or none of that batch, never of the run). The last log line says what happened per table.; e.g. `dbo.Customer` |
| `columns`                | Match on                 | list       | yes      |                                   | The rows deleted are those whose columns all equal these values (WHERE column = value AND ...). A value that is null or undefined is an error for that envelope: nothing is deleted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `columns[].column`       | Column                   | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `columns[].value`        | Value                    | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `ifNotFound`             | If no row matches        | select     |          | `"continue"`                      | Continue: the envelope goes on with {action: "notFound"}. Error: it goes to the On error policy.; one of `continue`, `error`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `batchSize`              | Batch size               | number     |          | `500`                             | The most rows per batch (one transaction); an envelope of another table closes the batch before that.; 1 to 5000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `timeoutS`               | Timeout (seconds)        | number     |          | `300`                             | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>

columns:
    - column: CustomerId
      value: $id
      expression: true

```

# SQL Server Execute

Runs any SQL on SQL Server (one or more statements; nothing checks what it does) once per envelope, in a transaction of its own: a COMMIT or ROLLBACK in the SQL is its own; what is still open at the end is committed (At the end: Commit, the default) or rolled back; an error rolls back. The `@name`s are parameters (a value or an expression on the envelope); a `{{name}}` is a schema or table name picked in the run (checked, then pasted) (or a list of names: a, b, c). The envelope goes on with {rowsAffected, rows, transaction} in its output key (default `sqlserver`). A test run runs nothing.

- Type: `sqlserver-execute` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `sqlserver` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: yes (a test run does not write)

## Settings

| Key                      | Label                    | Kind       | Required | Default                          | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------ | ---------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `connection`             | Connection               | connection |          |                                  | profile type `sqlserver`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
