To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env` |
| `connectWith`            | Connect with             | select     | yes      | `"fields"`                       | one of `fields`, `string`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `host`                   | Host                     | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `port`                   | Port                     | number     | yes      | `"1433"`                         | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `database`               | Database                 | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `user`                   | User                     | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `password`               | Password                 | secret     | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `encrypt`                | Encrypt                  | select     | yes      | `"on"`                           | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `trustServerCertificate` | Trust server certificate | select     | yes      | `"off"`                          | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `connectionString`       | Connection string        | secret     | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"string"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `sql`                    | SQL                      | code       | yes      |                                  | Any SQL, one or more statements, run as written in one transaction (a COMMIT or ROLLBACK in it is its own). Nothing checks what it does.; sql; e.g. `UPDATE dbo.Ticket SET Status = @status WHERE Id = @id`                                                                                    |
| `parameters`             | Parameters               | list       |          |                                  | Each @name the SQL uses, with its value (sent as a parameter); a {{name}} in the SQL (e.g. {{schema}}.briefs) is pasted as a name, after it is checked; a list of names (e.g. ["id", "name"]) is pasted as id, name, each item one simple name (no schema.name), an empty list an error.       |
| `parameters[].name`      | Name                     | text       | yes      |                                  | e.g. `id`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `parameters[].value`     | Value                    | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$id`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `atEnd`                  | At the end               | select     |          | `"commit"`                       | What happens to the transaction still open when the SQL ends without error: Commit, or Rollback (only what the SQL committed itself stays). An error always rolls back.; one of `commit`, `rollback`                                                                                           |
| `timeoutS`               | Timeout (seconds)        | number     |          | `300`                            | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>
sql: |-
    DELETE FROM dbo.ProjectItem WHERE BriefId = @briefId;
    INSERT INTO dbo.ProjectItem (BriefId, Name) SELECT @briefId, value FROM OPENJSON(@names);
parameters:
    - name: briefId
      value: $id
      expression: true
    - name: names
      value: JSON.stringify($projects.map(p => p.name))
      expression: true
atEnd: commit
```

---

# SQL Server Insert

Inserts one row per envelope into a SQL Server table, each column a value or an expression on the envelope (an identity or defaulted column can be left out). Rows go in batches of one table, each in one transaction (all or none of that batch); each envelope goes on with {action: "inserted"} in its output key (default `sqlserver`). A test run writes nothing.

- Type: `sqlserver-insert` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `sqlserver` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: yes (a test run does not write)

## Settings

| Key                      | Label                    | Kind       | Required | Default                           | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------ | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `connection`             | Connection               | connection |          |                                   | profile type `sqlserver`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `connectionName`         | Connection name          | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env`                                                                                                                                                               |
| `connectWith`            | Connect with             | select     | yes      | `"fields"`                        | one of `fields`, `string`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `host`                   | Host                     | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `port`                   | Port                     | number     | yes      | `"1433"`                          | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `database`               | Database                 | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `user`                   | User                     | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `password`               | Password                 | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `encrypt`                | Encrypt                  | select     | yes      | `"on"`                            | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `trustServerCertificate` | Trust server certificate | select     | yes      | `"off"`                           | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `connectionString`       | Connection string        | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"string"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `table`                  | Table                    | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | schema.table or table; with fx, an expression on the envelope (e.g. $tenant + ".customers"), its result checked the same way. A batch is one table: an envelope whose table is another closes the batch (envelopes sorted by table, e.g. a Sort before it, make full batches instead of small ones), and each batch is atomic on its own (all or none of that batch, never of the run). The last log line says what happened per table.; e.g. `dbo.Customer` |
| `columns`                | Columns                  | list       | yes      |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `columns[].column`       | Column                   | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `columns[].value`        | Value                    | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `batchSize`              | Batch size               | number     |          | `500`                             | The most rows per batch (one transaction); an envelope of another table closes the batch before that.; 1 to 5000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `timeoutS`               | Timeout (seconds)        | number     |          | `300`                             | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>
table: dbo.TicketHistory
columns:
    - column: TicketId
      value: $id
      expression: true
    - column: Status
      value: $status
      expression: true
    - column: ChangedAt
      value: new Date()
      expression: true
batchSize: 500
```

---

# SQL Server Query

Runs a read-only query (one SELECT or WITH) once per incoming envelope and yields one envelope per row, the columns written into DATA (Override: only the columns). The `@name`s are parameters, each a value or an expression on the envelope; a `{{name}}` is a schema or table name picked in the run (the parameter's value, checked: name or schema.name, letters, digits, _ and $). Connects with a connection profile of the workspace (its id in `connection`) or the component's own fields, the password always a secret.

- Type: `sqlserver` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key                      | Label                    | Kind       | Required | Default                          | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------ | ---------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `connection`             | Connection               | connection |          |                                  | profile type `sqlserver`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `connectionName`         | Connection name          | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}` | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env` |
| `connectWith`            | Connect with             | select     | yes      | `"fields"`                       | one of `fields`, `string`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `host`                   | Host                     | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `port`                   | Port                     | number     | yes      | `"1433"`                         | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `database`               | Database                 | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `user`                   | User                     | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `password`               | Password                 | secret     | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `encrypt`                | Encrypt                  | select     | yes      | `"on"`                           | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `trustServerCertificate` | Trust server certificate | select     | yes      | `"off"`                          | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `connectionString`       | Connection string        | secret     | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"string"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `sql`                    | Query                    | code       | yes      |                                  | sql; e.g. `SELECT id, name FROM Customer WHERE id > @since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `parameters`             | Parameters               | list       |          |                                  | Each @name the query uses, with its value; a {{name}} in the query (e.g. FROM {{schema}}.Customer) is pasted as a name, after it is checked; a list of names is pasted as a, b, c.                                                                                                             |
| `parameters[].name`      | Name                     | text       | yes      |                                  | e.g. `since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `parameters[].value`     | Value                    | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$PARAMETERS.since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `timeoutS`               | Timeout (seconds)        | number     |          | `300`                            | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>
sql: SELECT id, name, email FROM Customer WHERE updatedAt > @since
parameters:
    - name: since
      value: $PARAMETERS.since
      expression: true
timeoutS: 60
```

---

# SQL Server Update

Updates SQL Server rows, one UPDATE per envelope: the rows whose Match on columns equal the envelope's values get the other columns (each a value or an expression on the envelope). Optional expected values add independent WHERE conditions for compare-and-set. Batches of one table, in one transaction each (all or none of that batch). Each envelope goes on with {action: "updated", rows} or {action: "notFound"} in its output key (default `sqlserver`). It never inserts. A test run writes nothing.

- Type: `sqlserver-update` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `sqlserver` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: yes (a test run does not write)

## Settings

| Key                      | Label                                         | Kind       | Required | Default                           | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `connection`             | Connection                                    | connection |          |                                   | profile type `sqlserver`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `connectionName`         | Connection name                               | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env`                                                                                                                                                               |
| `connectWith`            | Connect with                                  | select     | yes      | `"fields"`                        | one of `fields`, `string`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `host`                   | Host                                          | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `port`                   | Port                                          | number     | yes      | `"1433"`                          | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `database`               | Database                                      | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `user`                   | User                                          | text       | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `password`               | Password                                      | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `encrypt`                | Encrypt                                       | select     | yes      | `"on"`                            | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `trustServerCertificate` | Trust server certificate                      | select     | yes      | `"off"`                           | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"fields"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `connectionString`       | Connection string                             | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and connectWith is `"string"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `table`                  | Table                                         | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | schema.table or table; with fx, an expression on the envelope (e.g. $tenant + ".customers"), its result checked the same way. A batch is one table: an envelope whose table is another closes the batch (envelopes sorted by table, e.g. a Sort before it, make full batches instead of small ones), and each batch is atomic on its own (all or none of that batch, never of the run). The last log line says what happened per table.; e.g. `dbo.Customer` |
| `columns`                | Columns (the Match on ones and those it sets) | list       | yes      |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `columns[].column`       | Column                                        | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `columns[].value`        | Value                                         | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `match`                  | Match on                                      | list       | yes      |                                   | The columns that find the rows to update (among the Columns, their values the WHERE); the other Columns are set.; each item is a plain value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `match[].column`         | Column                                        | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `id`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `conditions`             | Expected values (optional)                    | list       |          |                                   | More WHERE conditions, each column = its own value (null matches null), apart from the values set: compare-and-set, e.g. set Version = $version + 1 only where Version = $version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `conditions[].column`    | Column                                        | text       | yes      |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `conditions[].value`     | Expected value                                | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `ifNotFound`             | If no row matches                             | select     |          | `"continue"`                      | Continue: the envelope goes on with {action: "notFound"}. Error: it goes to the On error policy (e.g. a compare-and-set that lost to another run).; one of `continue`, `error`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `batchSize`              | Batch size                                    | number     |          | `500`                             | The most rows per batch (one transaction); an envelope of another table closes the batch before that.; 1 to 5000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `timeoutS`               | Timeout (seconds)                             | number     |          | `300`                             | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>
table: dbo.Ticket
columns:
    - column: Id
      value: $id
      expression: true
    - column: Status
      value: closed
      expression: false
    - column: ClosedAt
      value: new Date()
      expression: true
match:
    - Id
batchSize: 500
```

---

# HTTP Request

Sends one request per envelope (method, URL, query params, headers and body are values or expressions on it; $SECRETS works; the body as it is, or a multipart form of fields and text files) and the envelope goes on with {status, headers, body} in its output key (default `response`; a JSON body parsed). Authentication from an API connection of the workspace or the component. POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE write: a test run does not send them and the envelope goes on with {notSent: true}.

- Type: `http-request` (APIs)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `response` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: depends on its config (a test run does not write)

## Settings

| Key                   | Label                                 | Kind       | Required | Default                           | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `connection`          | Connection                            | connection |          |                                   | profile type `http-client`, `rest-basic`, `rest-oauth2`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `connectionName`      | Connection name                       | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env`   |
| `auth`                | Authentication                        | select     | yes      | `"none"`                          | one of `none`, `bearer`, `apiKey`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `token`               | Token                                 | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and auth is `"bearer"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `apiKeyHeader`        | Header name                           | text       | yes      | `"X-API-Key"`                     | only when connection is `""` and auth is `"apiKey"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `apiKey`              | API key                               | secret     | yes      |                                   | only when connection is `""` and auth is `"apiKey"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `method`              | Method                                | select     |          | `"GET"`                           | one of `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `url`                 | URL                                   | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | e.g. `https://api.example.com/orders`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `query`               | Query params                          | list       |          |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `query[].name`        | Name                                  | text       | yes      |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `query[].value`       | Value                                 | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `headers`             | Headers                               | list       |          |                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `headers[].name`      | Name                                  | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `Accept`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `headers[].value`     | Value                                 | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `bodyType`            | Body type                             | select     |          | `"raw"`                           | one of `raw`, `multipart`; only when method is `"POST"` or `"PUT"` or `"PATCH"` or `"DELETE"`                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `body`                | Body                                  | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | only when method is `"POST"` or `"PUT"` or `"PATCH"` or `"DELETE"` and bodyType is `"raw"`; e.g. `$DATA`                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `parts`               | Form parts                            | list       |          |                                   | Each part of the multipart/form-data body: a field, or a file when it has a file name. The content is text (an object goes as JSON); the Content-Type header with its boundary is set for you.; only when method is `"POST"` or `"PUT"` or `"PATCH"` or `"DELETE"` and bodyType is `"multipart"` |
| `parts[].name`        | Name                                  | text       | yes      |                                   | e.g. `file`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `parts[].value`       | Content                               | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$csv`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `parts[].filename`    | File name                             | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | e.g. `users.csv`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `parts[].contentType` | Content type                          | text       |          |                                   | e.g. `text/csv`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `timeoutS`            | Timeout (seconds)                     | number     |          | `30`                              | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `concurrency`         | Requests at once                      | number     |          | `1`                               | 1 to 20                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `failOnError`         | Fail on non-2xx                       | boolean    |          | `true`                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `retries`             | Retries on 429                        | number     |          | `3`                               | On 429 (Too Many Requests) the request is sent again after the server's Retry-After, or a backoff of 1 s, 2 s, 4 s... (with jitter). 0: never.; 0 to 10                                                                                                                                          |
| `retryOn503`          | Also retry on 503                     | boolean    |          | `false`                           | Retries on 503 (Service Unavailable) too: only for requests that can be sent twice (a GET, an idempotent PUT).                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `maxRetryWaitS`       | Longest wait before a retry (seconds) | number     |          | `60`                              | A Retry-After longer than this is not waited for: the answer goes on as it came (an error with Fail on non-2xx).; 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `responseHeaders`     | Response headers                      | select     |          | `"safe"`                          | one of `safe`, `none`, `all`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: ''
method: POST
url:
    value: https://api.example.com/orders
    expression: false
headers:
    - name: Accept
      value: application/json
      expression: false
body:
    value: $DATA
    expression: true
timeoutS: 30
concurrency: 4
failOnError: true
```

---

# Script Invoker

Calls, for each envelope, a function a project script exports (`path#name`), its arguments in the order of its parameters, each a value or an expression on the envelope. What it returns goes to the output key (default `result`), or with Override the whole DATA.

- Type: `script` (Scripting)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `result` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key                 | Label         | Kind            | Required | Default                           | Notes                                                                       |
| ------------------- | ------------- | --------------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `function`          | Function      | script-function | yes      |                                   |                                                                             |
| `functionPath`      | Function path | value           | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | only when function is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'pricing/' + $country + '#total'` |
| `arguments`         | Arguments     | list            |          |                                   |                                                                             |
| `arguments[].name`  | Name          | text            | yes      |                                   |                                                                             |
| `arguments[].value` | Value         | value           |          | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`                           |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
function: pricing/tax#total
arguments:
    - name: amount
      value: $price
      expression: true
    - name: country
      value: US
      expression: false
```

---

# TypeScript

Runs `async function process($input)` for each envelope ($input is its DATA). It can import the project's scripts: `import { f } from '@myproject/scripts/<path>'`. Its return goes to the output key (default `result`); with Override it is the whole DATA (object = 1 envelope, list = 1 per item, null = none). A throw is the envelope's error (rethrow(e): another component's, naming where it began). Globals: $PARAMETERS, $SECRETS, $VARIABLES, $FLOW_CURRENT_RUN, log(), rethrow(). Top-level code runs anew per component run (each Loop iteration, called flow); globalThis is shared by the run.

- Type: `typescript` (Scripting)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `result` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key    | Label | Kind | Required | Default                                                        | Notes      |
| ------ | ----- | ---- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `code` | Code  | code | yes      | `"async function process($input: Data) {\n  return null\n}\n"` | typescript |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
code: |
    async function process($input: Data) {
      return { total: $input.price * $input.quantity };
    }
```

---

# Aggregate

Groups the envelopes into batches of N, or All of them in one batch when the input ends, and yields one envelope per batch with the list of DATA in a field (default `items`): {items: [DATA, ...]}. The last batch may be smaller. With "Empty list when nothing arrives", an input that ends empty yields {items: []}. Use it before a component that writes many records at once, or one that needs them all (a CSV of a whole query).

- Type: `aggregate` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key         | Label                           | Kind    | Required | Default   | Notes                                  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `mode`      | Batch size                      | select  |          | `"size"`  | one of `size`, `all`                   |
| `size`      | Envelopes per batch             | number  |          | `500`     | 1 to 10000; only when mode is `"size"` |
| `field`     | Field                           | text    | yes      | `"items"` | e.g. `items`                           |
| `whenEmpty` | Empty list when nothing arrives | boolean |          | `false`   |                                        |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
mode: size
size: 500
field: items
```

---

# Data Grid

A table typed into the component: for each incoming envelope (usually the Start's only one) yields one envelope per row, the columns written into DATA (Override: only the columns). Cells are text converted by the column type (text, number, boolean); an empty cell is null. Good for mappings (into a Lookup's lookup input) and test data.

- Type: `datagrid` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key       | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Notes                              |
| --------- | ----- | ---- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `columns` | Data  | grid | yes      |         | one of `text`, `number`, `boolean` |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
columns:
    - name: code
      type: text
    - name: rate
      type: number
rows:
    - - BR
      - '0.17'
    - - US
      - '0.07'
```

# Distinct

Lets through (out-0) only the first envelope of each key and sends the repeated ones to the duplicates output (out-1, may stay unconnected). The key is a list of expressions; without any, the whole DATA. Values compare as JSON.

- Type: `distinct` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0` (unique), `out-1` (duplicates) optional
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key          | Label | Kind       | Required | Default | Notes                      |
| ------------ | ----- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------- |
| `keys`       | Keys  | list       |          |         | each item is a plain value |
| `keys[].key` | Key   | expression | yes      |         | e.g. `$email`              |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
keys:
    - $email
```

---

# Filter

Evaluates a condition (an expression) on each envelope and sends it, unchanged, to the true output (out-0) or the false one (out-1, may stay unconnected: dropped). JavaScript truthiness: 0, '' and null are false.

- Type: `filter` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0` (true), `out-1` (false) optional
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key         | Label     | Kind       | Required | Default | Notes              |
| ----------- | --------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------ |
| `condition` | Condition | expression | yes      |         | e.g. `$price > 10` |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
condition: $total > 100 && $status === 'open'
```

---

# Limit

Lets only N envelopes through, unchanged: the first N as they arrive (top) or the last N when the input ends (bottom). Handy to test a flow on a sample. Last 1 is a barrier: one envelope goes on only after every component before it finished with every envelope (e.g. to advance a checkpoint or release a lock once); nothing goes on when no envelope arrives.

- Type: `limit` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key     | Label     | Kind   | Required | Default | Notes                  |
| ------- | --------- | ------ | -------- | ------- | ---------------------- |
| `mode`  | Keep      | select |          | `"top"` | one of `top`, `bottom` |
| `count` | Envelopes | number |          | `10`    | 1 to 1000000           |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
mode: top
count: 10
```

---

# Lookup

For each envelope of the input (in-0), finds the envelope of the lookup input (in-1) with the same key and writes its whole DATA into the output key (default `lookup`; null when not found, or a not found output). Reads the whole lookup input into memory first. Keys compare as text; the first repeated key wins.

- Type: `lookup` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0` (input) one edge only, `in-1` (lookup) one edge only
- Outputs: `out-0`; the outputs depend on the config (see the description)
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `lookup` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key             | Label        | Kind       | Required | Default  | Notes                   |
| --------------- | ------------ | ---------- | -------- | -------- | ----------------------- |
| `keys`          | Keys         | list       | yes      |          |                         |
| `keys[].main`   | Input        | expression | yes      |          | e.g. `$customerId`      |
| `keys[].lookup` | Lookup       | expression | yes      |          | e.g. `$id`              |
| `ifNotFound`    | If not found | select     |          | `"null"` | one of `null`, `output` |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
keys:
    - main: $customerId
      lookup: $id
ifNotFound: 'null'
```

---

# Mapper

Writes fields into the envelope's DATA: each field is a value (fixed or an expression on the incoming envelope) and the key it goes to; a key that exists is replaced. Sources are evaluated on the incoming envelope. Override: the output DATA has only the mapped fields.

- Type: `mapper` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key               | Label               | Kind  | Required | Default                          | Notes                                                                        |
| ----------------- | ------------------- | ----- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fields`          | Fields              | list  | yes      |                                  |                                                                              |
| `fields[].value`  | Source (value)      | value |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$price * $quantity` |
| `fields[].target` | Key in the envelope | text  | yes      |                                  | e.g. `total`                                                                 |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
fields:
    - target: total
      value: $price * $quantity
      expression: true
    - target: currency
      value: USD
      expression: false
```

# Router

Sends each envelope, unchanged, to the output of the first case whose condition is true (one output per case, in order), or to the last output, else (may stay unconnected: dropped).

- Type: `router` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0` (big), `out-1` (medium), `out-2` (else) optional; one output per case (named by the case), then the else output, the last one (optional)
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key                 | Label     | Kind       | Required | Default | Notes                |
| ------------------- | --------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------- |
| `cases`             | Cases     | list       | yes      |         |                      |
| `cases[].label`     | Name      | text       |          |         | e.g. `big`           |
| `cases[].condition` | Condition | expression | yes      |         | e.g. `$total > 1000` |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
cases:
    - label: big
      condition: $total > 1000
    - label: medium
      condition: $total > 100
```

---

# Sort

Reads every envelope, sorts them by a list of keys (an expression and ascending/descending; the next keys break ties, stable) and only then yields them. null and undefined go last. Holds the whole input in memory.

- Type: `sort` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key                | Label | Kind       | Required | Default | Notes                |
| ------------------ | ----- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------- |
| `keys`             | Keys  | list       | yes      |         |                      |
| `keys[].value`     | Key   | expression | yes      |         | e.g. `$price`        |
| `keys[].direction` | Order | select     |          | `"asc"` | one of `asc`, `desc` |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
keys:
    - value: $createdAt
      direction: desc
    - value: $id
      direction: asc
```

# Split

The opposite of Aggregate: evaluates an expression that gives a list (default `$items`) and yields one envelope per item, the item as the whole DATA. Every item must be an object; an empty list yields nothing.

- Type: `split` (Transformation)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key    | Label | Kind       | Required | Default    | Notes         |
| ------ | ----- | ---------- | -------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| `list` | List  | expression | yes      | `"$items"` | e.g. `$items` |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
list: $items
```

# Break

Only inside a Loop (`loop: <its id>`): an envelope that reaches it ends the loop after the iteration (it does not go out of the Loop), and wins over a Continue with or a Next reached in the same iteration. It does not cut the iteration short; no output.

- Type: `break` (Flow)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: none
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

No settings.

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
{}
```

---

# Continue with

Only inside a Loop (`loop: <its id>`): the envelope that reaches it is the loop state of the next iteration. More than one in an iteration is an error of the Loop for that input envelope. It does not cut the iteration short; no output.

- Type: `continue` (Flow)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: none
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

No settings.

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
{}
```

---

# Discard

The end of a path that leads nowhere on purpose: drops every envelope that reaches it (no output) and logs how many.

- Type: `discard` (Flow)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: none
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

No settings.

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
{}
```
