# Flow Invoker

Runs another flow of the project for each envelope, passing its Start's parameters and, with Send an input, the envelope's DATA or an expression as its input. Wait: each envelope that reaches the other flow's End goes out as it arrives, its DATA merged into the caller's; none reaching it, nothing goes out (not a signal that it finished: see the barrier pattern). Fire and forget: the envelope goes on at once and batches of them start runs of their own. An editor's run (Run, Run for real) calls the other flow's draft.

- Type: `flow` (Flow)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert` (On error is throw when call is fire-and-forget)
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key                  | Label                     | Kind    | Required | Default                           | Notes                                                                                                           |
| -------------------- | ------------------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `flowId`             | Flow                      | flow    | yes      |                                   |                                                                                                                 |
| `flowPath`           | Flow path                 | value   | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | only when flowId is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Imports/' + $source + '/Load'`                                         |
| `call`               | Call                      | select  |          | `"wait"`                          | one of `wait`, `fire-and-forget`                                                                                |
| `batchSize`          | Batch size                | number  |          | `100`                             | 1 to 10000; only when call is `"fire-and-forget"`                                                               |
| `parameters`         | Parameters                | list    |          |                                   |                                                                                                                 |
| `parameters[].name`  | Name                      | text    | yes      |                                   |                                                                                                                 |
| `parameters[].value` | Value                     | value   |          | `{"value":"","expression":false}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`                                                               |
| `sendEnvelope`       | Send an input to the flow | boolean |          |                                   |                                                                                                                 |
| `inputSource`        | Input                     | select  |          | `"data"`                          | one of `data`, `expression`; only when sendEnvelope is `true`                                                   |
| `input`              | Input expression          | value   |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}`  | only when sendEnvelope is `true` and inputSource is `"expression"`; e.g. `{id: $id, total: $price * $quantity}` |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
flowId: <flow id>
call: wait
parameters:
    - name: customerId
      value: $id
      expression: true
sendEnvelope: true
inputSource: data
```

---

# Log

Evaluates a message (an expression on the envelope) and records it in the run's log of the component; the envelope goes on unchanged. Debug lines only show in the editor's test runs.

- Type: `log` (Flow)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key       | Label   | Kind       | Required | Default  | Notes                                   |
| --------- | ------- | ---------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `level`   | Level   | select     |          | `"info"` | one of `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` |
| `message` | Message | expression | yes      |          | e.g. `ˋorder ${$id}ˋ`                   |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
level: info
message: '`order ${$id}: ${$total}`'
```

---

# Loop

Runs its loop region (nodes with `loop: <its id>`) again and again; each input envelope runs a loop of its own, in arrival order (parallel: 10 at once). Each iteration starts at iteration-start with the loop state (that envelope); what reaches iteration-end goes out as it arrives. The stop condition (on the loop state and $_loopIndex, 0 first) is checked before each iteration, or from the second with checkTiming after (do-while): true ends the loop. Max iterations ends it with a warning (50 in a test run). A failed iteration ends that loop: it is the Loop's error for that envelope (On error).

- Type: `loop` (Flow)
- Inputs: `in-0` one edge only, `iteration-end` (Iteration end)
- Outputs: `out-0` one edge only, `iteration-start` (Iteration start)
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key             | Label                    | Kind       | Required | Default    | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------- | ------------------------ | ---------- | -------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `maxIterations` | Max iterations           | number     | yes      | `100`      | A safety limit: the loop ends after this many iterations, with a warning (50 at most in a test run).; 1 to 100000                                                                              |
| `stopCondition` | Stop condition           | expression |          |            | An expression on the loop state and $_loopIndex: true ends the loop. Empty: only max iterations ends it.; e.g. `$_loopIndex >= 10 \\                                                           | \\  | !$hasMore` |
| `checkTiming`   | Check the stop condition | select     |          | `"before"` | one of `before`, `after`                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `parallel`      | Parallel                 | boolean    |          | `false`    | Runs the loops of several input envelopes at the same time, up to 10 at once (the rest wait); their output goes out interleaved, as it arrives. Off: one loop after another, in arrival order. |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
maxIterations: 100
stopCondition: $_loopIndex >= $pages
checkTiming: before
```

---

# Next

Only inside a Loop (`loop: <its id>`): an envelope that reaches it ends the iteration right away (what is still running in it stops; what reached Iteration end already went out) and the next one starts, with the loop state as it is (a Continue with reached before it still sets it). No output.

- Type: `next` (Flow)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: none
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: no
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

No settings.

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
{}
```

---

# Wait

Holds the envelopes of `hold` until `watch` ends (everything before it finished), then lets each go on with {status: success | failure | empty, envelopes, errors, firstError, last} in its output key (default `wait`). Connect the output and the error port of what is watched to `watch`. `envelopes` counts only the watched ones without errors, `errors` those with DATA.errors: watched = envelopes + errors. Always answers, even when nothing was watched (empty).

- Type: `wait` (Flow)
- Inputs: `in-0` (hold), `in-1` (watch)
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: `wait` by default (the node's `outputKey` changes it)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

No settings.

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
{}
```
